source: Kapchorua Tea Kenya Plc audited group statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the year ended 31 March 2026, from the signed annual report and financial statements, audited by PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP with the auditor report dated 25 June 2026. Figures printed in Shs thousands and stored in KES. Revenue 1,662,674, cost of sales 1,396,359, gross profit 316,939, other income 2,522, interest income 53,201, finance income 21,764, distribution costs 80,392, administrative expenses 25,014, profit before tax 289,020, income tax 92,077, profit for the year 196,943, basic and diluted earnings per share 12.58. Gross profit is operating income (revenue plus the 50,624 fair value gain on biological assets) less cost of sales, which is how the issuer prints it and how the earlier years in this file are already stored. Operating expenses is distribution costs plus administrative expenses, and operating profit is gross profit plus other income less those, so profit before tax equals operating profit plus net finance income (214,055 plus 74,965 equals 289,020) and profit before tax less tax equals profit for the year exactly.
source_note: Farmed from the kenyanstocks.com statement API on 2026-09-21. FY2023 and FY2022 stay empty: the filing carries two columns only. Note that the stored Cost of Sales and Gross Profit carry the fair value movement on biological assets (Revenue less Cost of Sales plus fair value change = Gross Profit), which is why the cost of sales identity alone does not tie for this issuer. | CRON 2026-10-05: cells filled from the kenyanstocks.com financial statements API harvest where the file held no value for that year; sign convention taken from the years the file and the source share, and applied only where every shared year agreed.

reconciliation_note: Net Profit (computed) matches the source's period total on every period. Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit does not hold in FY2025, FY2024: the filed gross profit ties to the filed operating profit, so the revenue and cost of sales columns are a presentation difference rather than a broken subtotal; all three figures are shown unchanged. Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit does not hold in FY2023, FY2022: this statement does not present gross profit as revenue less one cost-of-sales line, so the two-row identity does not apply; the figures are as filed. Operating Profit (EBIT) less Net Finance Costs plus Other Income equals Profit Before Tax does not hold in FY2025, FY2024: the statement bridges operating profit to profit before tax through further lines (Gains / (Losses) From Changes In Fair Value Of Biological Assets - Fuel Trees; Gains / (Losses) From Changes In Fair Value Of Biological Assets - Timber Trees; Gains / (Losses) From Changes In Fair Value Of Biological Assets - Unharvested Green Leaf; Interest Income; Net Interest Income Total) and the file's own bridge reproduces the filed profit before tax; both figures are shown unchanged.
